press_references.value: Telegram Gets New Rich Text Editor, Communities, and Ephemeral Bot Messages

product_launches.description: Telegram launched a new Rich Text Editor for Premium users, enabling formatted messages with headings, tables, lists, quotes, code blocks, and embedded media, integrated with its Cocoon-powered AI tools.

press_references.value: Telegram Has a New Wear OS App

product_launches.description: Telegram has launched a new Wear OS companion app, enabling users to send and receive messages, view media, manage chats, and more directly from their smartwatch.

press_references.value: Telegram 推出 Bot-to-Bot 通信功能，支持 AI Agent 之间直接交互

product_launches.description: Telegram launched a Bot-to-Bot communication capability and several new AI bot features, enabling bots and AI agents to interact directly and automate complex workflows on the platform.

press_references.value: Telegram Update Introduces AI Text Editor, Enhanced Polls, And Document Scanning

product_launches.description: Telegram released a major update to its Android and iOS apps, adding an AI-powered text editor, enhanced polling tools, media-attached polls, bot-management APIs, security warnings for unofficial clients, and a built-in document scanner with Live/Motion Photo support.

press_references.value: Telegram for Android redesign goes all-in on Liquid Glass, rolling out now

product_launches.description: Telegram released version 12.4.0 of its Android app, introducing a major UI redesign with a new Liquid Glass-inspired interface and four-tab bottom navigation.

press_references.value: Transcript for Pavel Durov: Telegram, Freedom, Censorship, Money, Power & Human Nature | Lex Fridman Podcast #482

product_launches.description: Telegram launched 'Telegram Gifts', blockchain-based digital collectibles integrated into user profiles and powered by TON. The feature supports gifting, ownership and secondary trading, has featured high-profile drops (e.g., Snoop Dogg), and helped drive strong NFT activity on TON.

press_references.value: Telegram Rolls Out Checklists, Suggested Posts and Monetisation Tools in Channels

product_launches.description: Telegram has launched new features including collaborative checklists, suggested posts, and monetisation tools for channel creators, enhancing user engagement and enabling creators to earn revenue directly within the app.

press_references.value: Telegram Update Brings DMs to Channels, Voice Message Trimming, and More Features

product_launches.description: Telegram has launched a major app update introducing direct messages to channels, voice message trimming, a new tab layout for group topics, HD photo sharing, and enhanced poll options, improving user experience and creator-subscriber interactions.

press_references.value: Extra-Secure Group Calls, Automated Accounts, and More

product_launches.description: Telegram launched extra-secure, end-to-end encrypted group calls, allowing up to 200 users, with features like call links, QR codes, and blockchain-like security.

overview_description.description: Telegram is a cloud-based, cross-platform instant messaging service focusing on speed, security, and massive group capabilities, offering end-to-end encryption for secret chats and voice calls. It allows users to share files of any type, creates groups of up to 200,000 members, and manages channels for broadcasting to unlimited audiences, all while syncing seamlessly across devices.

press_references.value: Australia begins legal action against Telegram over alleged pro-terror material after Russia's charges on Durov

legal_proceedings.description: Australia's eSafety Commissioner has begun regulatory legal action against Telegram, alleging that the platform failed to remove videos showing terrorist executions and mass shootings. Noncompliance could expose Telegram to civil penalties of up to A$54.6 million.

press_references.value: MIB Issues Notice To Telegram To Remove Pirated Content, Identifies 3142 Channels

legal_proceedings.description: India’s Ministry of Information and Broadcasting issued a notice to Telegram under the IT Act directing it to remove pirated films and OTT content from 3,142 identified channels, increasing regulatory pressure on the platform over piracy.

press_references.value: Moscow chokes Telegram as it pushes state-backed rival app

legal_proceedings.description: Russian internet watchdog Roskomnadzor has imposed phased throttling and restrictions on Telegram in Russia for alleged violations of data-localization and anti-terrorism laws, part of broader enforcement actions against foreign platforms.

press_references.value: From dance style to dialogues, ‘Dabangg’ actor Salman Khan moves Delhi High Court for protection of personality rights

legal_proceedings.description: Telegram has been cited as a defendant in Salman Khans Delhi High Court lawsuit alleging misuse of his personality rights via AI, morphing, and unauthorized content and merchandise, and was directed to treat the action as a formal IT Act complaint under the 2021 intermediary rules.

press_references.value: Teen Sues Developer Of AI 'Clothes Removal' App After Classmate Created Deepfake Nude

legal_proceedings.description: Telegram was named as a nominal defendant in the lawsuit for hosting bots that provided access to the ClothOff tool implicated in creating nonconsensual deepfake images.

press_references.value: Telegram CEO Pavel Durov questioned by French authorities over platform’s role in criminal activities: Report

legal_proceedings.description: Telegram is under judicial investigation by French authorities for allegedly failing to remove illegal content, including child sexual abuse material and content promoting drug trafficking and extremism. The investigation also examines CEO Pavel Durov's legal accountability for these alleged failures.

press_references.value: Govt 'proactively monitoring' Telegram over concerns about illegal content

legal_proceedings.description: The Indian government, via the Home Ministry's Cybercrime Coordination Centre, submitted a report in court as part of its successful defence of a one‑week ban on Telegram in India over alleged misuse of the platform for exam leaks, child sexual abuse material and cyber fraud.

press_references.value: Vietnam orders messaging app Telegram to be blocked citing criminal misuse: Report

legal_proceedings.description: Vietnam's government has ordered telecom companies to block Telegram, citing the app's failure to cooperate in criminal investigations and its alleged use for illegal activities. The move is part of a broader regulatory crackdown on OTT services.

press_references.value: Telegram pledges to exit the market rather than "undermine encryption with backdoors"

legal_proceedings.description: French authorities arrested Telegram CEO Pavel Durov in August 2024, accusing him of providing encrypted services to criminals. An investigation is currently happening.

press_references.value: Rising cost of vehicle spare parts in France leads to increase in thefts

legal_proceedings.description: Telegram's founder, Pavel Durov, was arrested in August 2024, and he is being held in custody while a number of crimes linked to the platform are investigated, including enabling illegal transactions by an organised group.
